name: Neuchâtel gas-turbine electricity generation
description: A stationary gas turbine drove an electricity generator at the Neuchâtel municipal power station.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

events.statement: Brown Boveri’s gas turbine was installed at Neuchâtel’s municipal power station in 1939.

evidence.supports: ASME says Brown Boveri built the machine installed in 1939 at Neuchâtel municipal power station, and reports 4 MW output and 17.4 percent efficiency; it notes commercial operation but not a separate start date.

events.caveats: ASME describes successful commercial operation but does not establish whether it commenced in 1939 or give a separate commencement date.
